note: Patcher matrix for B189, built from fix/b189-lounger-orientation-sw at d0d1fd7. B189 exists for ONE player-reported defect: the spa lounger orientation (#330). The owner playtested the published B188 patcher and reported 7 of 8 items GOOD in actual play -- exercise bike drop labels, treadmill targeting, bike autonomous selection, ping-pong, home gym drop-in-place, yoga, and the patio drinks position -- with one lounger correct and one wrong. ROOT CAUSE: VF2FurnitureFacesNorthWest tested `orientation == 3`. The owner confirmed a lounger only ever occupies TWO orientations and a live capture showed those are 0 and 1, so `== 3` never matched a real lounger and BOTH placements took the northeast arm. Orientation 0 wants northeast so it looked right by luck; orientation 1 wants northwest and was the broken one. THE FIX IS GATED, and that gating is the substance of it. Codex review caught that the reclined-pose branch `if (info.orientation == 1 || VF2SpaLoungerHasHandle(...))` admits ordinary and mobile Lounge Chairs at orientation 1 despite its own comment claiming to be spa-scoped, so changing the shared predicate would have regressed loungers the owner had already confirmed working. The spa rule now lives in VF2SpaLoungerFacesNorthWest, which returns false unless the handle is a spa lounger; the shared predicate is restored to `orientation == 3` for chaises and the hammock. A truth table over every combination that can reach that branch shows EXACTLY ONE REACHABLE ROW CHANGES: orientation 1 on a spa lounger, NE -> NW. Ordinary Lounge Chairs at orientation 1 are byte-identical. SEEDED FROM B188, NOT AN OLDER RELEASE. VF2 builds inherit ASSETS from the seed, so a seed predating B188 would silently drop the Exercise Bike (0x99) and Ping-Pong Table (0x9a) content maps that B188 added, and the build would still report success. All 32 B188 seed directories were confirmed present before this file was written. Seeds supply assets ONLY: every overlay is rebuilt from the current generator and must be verified individually, because nothing in the release path inspects overlay bytes. Export with work/export_release_bundle.py, NEVER work/export_offline_patch_bundle.py directly -- B183 shipped twelve features short precisely because the low-level exporter was called directly and the wrapper's guards never ran. NOT PLAYTESTED AT THE TIME OF THIS BUILD. The lounger fix has static evidence only: 115 tests across four lounger/orientation suites, five independent mutations caught, and the emitted C++ compiles. Issue #330 stays open until the owner confirms both loungers in play on this artifact.
